Professional Summary

- Containerized services with Docker and automated deployments to AWS, using CI pipelines and Git-based workflows tracked in Jira to accelerate release cadence.

Go Developer, NimbusSoft (Nov 2020 - Sep 2025)
- Built Go microservices that produced and consumed high-volume events via Apache Kafka, scaling consumers to process 200k+ messages/minute and ensuring idempotent writes to PostgreSQL.
- Designed gRPC endpoints for internal service communication and optimized database interactions with connection pooling and Redis caching, reducing average API response times by 40%.
- Packaged services with Docker, managed deployments on AWS, and maintained CI/CD pipelines with Git; tracked work and incidents through Jira and operated services on Linux hosts.
